scripts.dev: npm run build -w @starlite/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @starlite/api" "npm run dev -w @starlite/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @starlite/contracts && npm run build -w @starlite/web && npm run build -w @starlite/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @starlite/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run format:check
